title: Chapter 70 — Market Intelligence for Trade Clients
intro: Intelligence as a service and the advisor position.

sections.title: Information Is Value
sections.content:
Share relevant intelligence with your trade clients: new product launches, discontinued models, lead-time changes, promotional opportunities, building code updates, market trends.

When you become a source of useful information, you become an advisor — not just a supplier. Advisors are harder to replace.

sections.title: Coaching Rule
sections.content:
When evaluating intelligence sharing, ask:

Is the salesperson proactively sharing relevant information with trade clients?
Are they positioned as an advisor — or just an order-taker?
